identity_reason: it is the List inset pane and its hairline rows, so only the windowing that draws rows in view is new
concept: A long list in one pane that draws only the rows in view, each row saying where it sits in the whole list.

root.why: the list is one scrolling level-2 pane with its own edge

list.why: the inner list is as tall as all its rows so the scrollbar is truthful

row.why: each row sits at its own offset with a hairline under it

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks so every part stays findable

focus-visible.why: the pane shows the focus ring so it can be scrolled by keyboard

data-pane-card.why: inside a Card the card glass already blurs and dims the scene, so this drops its own filter and stays the inner level

data-pane-surface.why: inside any other pane that marks itself a surface it likewise drops its own filter and stays the inner level
